glossary.definition: (A) "Construction" means the building and initial equipping of new structures.
glossary.source_title: Section 5139.271 - Granting financial assistance to counties.

glossary.definition: (B) "Acquisition" means "acquisition" as defined in the rules of the department, which may include the purchase, remodeling, and initial equipping of existing structures.
glossary.source_title: Section 5139.271 - Granting financial assistance to counties.
